title: Brown's Navy resignation letter

tellings.quote: Townsend gets a letter telling him he is supposed to transfer his equipment from the University of Philadelphia to the Navy at Norfolk.

plain: In 1942, the story goes, the scientist Townsend Brown got a letter telling him to move his equipment from the University of Philadelphia to the Navy at Norfolk, Virginia. The researcher Jan Lundquist tells it in a documentary about Brown and credits a document she calls Brown's resignation letter, though she gives only her own summary of it, not its words. She tells it as a step in Brown's wartime work moving into Navy hands.
